lookup_lang2_to_lang3: lookup the ISO 639-3 code for a given ISO 639-1 language code using LANG2_LANG3
lookup_lang3_to_lang2: lookup the ISO 639-1 code for a given ISO 639-3 language code using LANG3_LANG2
convert_language_code: convert a language code from ISO 639-1 format to ISO 639-3 format
reverse_language_mapping: reverse the LANG2_LANG3 mapping to get LANG3_LANG2 for inverse lookups
validate_language_code: validate whether a language code exists in the LANG2_LANG3 or LANG3_LANG2 mapping
